mapper.sql: id, report_id, family_member_id, report_year, item_name, item_group, value_num, value_text, unit, ref_low, ref_high, abnormal_flag, sort_no, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO health_indicator (report_id, family_member_id, report_year, item_name, item_group, value_num, value_text, unit, ref_low, ref_high, abnormal_flag, sort_no) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{familyMemberId}, #{reportYear}, #{itemName}, #{itemGroup}, #{valueNum}, #{valueText}, #{unit}, #{refLow}, #{refHigh}, #{abnormalFlag}, #{sortNo})
mapper.select: SELECT id, report_id FROM health_indicator WHERE item_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
